sentences.text: Appearance:
Shri Baboo Ji Chourasia - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Pramod Choubey - G.A. appearing on behalf of res  ORDER

This is first bail application filed on behalf of applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
2.

The applicant is in jail since 22.05.2025 connection with Crime No.365 of 2025 registered at P.S.
Mauganj, District-Mauganj for the offence punishable under Section 376(2) (N) of IPC.
3. Prosecution story, in brief is that applicant repeatedly established physical relationship with prosecutrix aged 37 years on false pretext of marriage.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that as per prosecution story, incident is said to have occurred on 14.2.2023 and FIR has been lodged on 20.05.2023.
It is also urged that prosecutrix is a major widowed lady.
Report has been lodged only after prosecutrix came to know that applicant is getting married.
Applicant is in custody since 22.05.2025.
No NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:37048 2 MCRC-31504-2025 custodial interrogation is required.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on bail.
5. Learned GA for the respondent/State has opposed the bail application.

sentences.text: 6. Looking to overall facts and circumstances of the case, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9. Soft copy of this bail order be sent immediately/forthwith to the applicant through concerned Jail Superintendent.
10. M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
11. Certified copy as per rules.
